abbott_smith_html:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;]
a man, Lat. vir.
__1. As opposite to a woman, Act.8:12, 1Ti.2:12; as a husband, Mat.1:16, Jhn.4:16, Rom.7:2, Tit.1:6.
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1Co.13:11, Eph.4:13, Jas.3:2.
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Luk.5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, Act.1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, Act.22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
__4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Luk.8:41, Act.6:11.
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a man (properly as an individual male)

occurrences.kjv: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

occurrences.bsb: In Lystra there sat a man crippled in his feet, who was lame from birth and had never walked.
occurrences.kjv: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked:

occurrences.bsb: “Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

occurrences.bsb: After much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that in the early days God made a choice among you that the Gentiles would hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.
occurrences.kjv: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

occurrences.bsb: When they had finished speaking, James declared, “Brothers, listen to me!
occurrences.kjv: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

occurrences.bsb: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to select men from among them to send to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas called Barsabbas and Silas, two leaders among the brothers,
occurrences.kjv: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

occurrences.bsb: So we all agreed to choose men to send to you along with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
occurrences.kjv: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

occurrences.bsb: During the night, Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and pleading with him, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”
occurrences.kjv: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

occurrences.bsb: The Jews, however, became jealous. So they brought in some troublemakers from the marketplace, formed a mob, and sent the city into an uproar. They raided Jason’s house in search of Paul and Silas, hoping to bring them out to the people.
occurrences.kjv: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

occurrences.bsb: As a result, many of them believed, along with quite a few prominent Greek women and men.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said, “Men of Athens, I see that in every way you are very religious.
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

occurrences.bsb: For He has set a day when He will judge the world with justice by the Man He has appointed. He has given proof of this to everyone by raising Him from the dead.”
occurrences.kjv: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: But some joined him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, a woman named Damaris, and others who were with them.
occurrences.kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile a Jew named Apollos, a native of Alexandria, came to Ephesus. He was an eloquent man, well versed in the Scriptures.
occurrences.kjv: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

occurrences.bsb: There were about twelve men in all.
occurrences.kjv: And all the men were about twelve.

occurrences.bsb: Demetrius assembled the craftsmen, along with the workmen in related trades. “Men,” he said, “you know that this business is our source of prosperity.
occurrences.kjv: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

occurrences.bsb: Finally the city clerk quieted the crowd and declared, “Men of Ephesus, doesn’t everyone know that the city of Ephesus is guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?
occurrences.kjv: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?

occurrences.bsb: For you have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed our temple nor blasphemed our goddess.
occurrences.kjv: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

occurrences.bsb: Even from your own number, men will rise up and distort the truth to draw away disciples after them.
occurrences.kjv: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

occurrences.bsb: Coming over to us, he took Paul’s belt, bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘In this way the Jews of Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and hand him over to the Gentiles.’”
occurrences.kjv: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul’s girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore do what we advise you. There are four men with us who have taken a vow.
occurrences.kjv: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;

occurrences.bsb: So the next day Paul took the men and purified himself along with them. Then he entered the temple to give notice of the date when their purification would be complete and the offering would be made for each of them.
occurrences.kjv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.

occurrences.bsb: crying out, “Men of Israel, help us! This is the man who teaches everyone everywhere against our people and against our law and against this place. Furthermore, he has brought Greeks into the temple and defiled this holy place.”
occurrences.kjv: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.

occurrences.bsb: “Aren’t you the Egyptian who incited a rebellion some time ago and led four thousand members of the Assassins into the wilderness?”
occurrences.kjv: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?

occurrences.bsb: “Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense before you.”
occurrences.kjv: Men, brethren, and fathers, hear ye my defence which I make now unto you.

occurrences.bsb: “I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but raised in this city. I was educated at the feet of Gamaliel in strict conformity to the law of our fathers. I was just as zealous for God as any of you are today.
occurrences.kjv: I am verily a man which am a Jew, born in Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, yet brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, and taught according to the perfect manner of the law of the fathers, and was zealous toward God, as ye all are this day.

occurrences.bsb: I persecuted this Way even to the death, detaining both men and women and throwing them into prison,
occurrences.kjv: And I persecuted this way unto the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women.

occurrences.bsb: There a man named Ananias, a devout observer of the law who was highly regarded by all the Jews living there,
occurrences.kjv: And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there,

occurrences.bsb: Paul looked directly at the Sanhedrin and said, “Brothers, I have conducted myself before God in all good conscience to this day.”
occurrences.kjv: And Paul, earnestly beholding the council, said, Men and brethren, I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day.

occurrences.bsb: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and the others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, “Brothers, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee. It is because of my hope in the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial.”
occurrences.kjv: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees, and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, Men and brethren, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee: of the hope and resurrection of the dead I am called in question.

occurrences.bsb: Do not let them persuade you, because more than forty men are waiting to ambush him. They have bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him; they are ready now, awaiting your consent.”
occurrences.kjv: But do not thou yield unto them: for there lie in wait for him of them more than forty men, which have bound themselves with an oath, that they will neither eat nor drink till they have killed him: and now are they ready, looking for a promise from thee.

occurrences.bsb: This man was seized by the Jews, and they were about to kill him when I came with my troops to rescue him. For I had learned that he is a Roman citizen,
occurrences.kjv: This man was taken of the Jews, and should have been killed of them: then came I with an army, and rescued him, having understood that he was a Roman.

occurrences.bsb: When I was informed that there was a plot against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also instructed his accusers to present their case against him before you.
occurrences.kjv: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man, I sent straightway to thee, and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him. Farewell.

occurrences.bsb: We have found this man to be a pestilence, stirring up dissension among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,
occurrences.kjv: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

occurrences.bsb: So if this man has done anything wrong, let some of your leaders come down with me and accuse him there.”
occurrences.kjv: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

occurrences.bsb: Since they were staying several days, Festus laid out Paul’s case before the king: “There is a certain man whom Felix left in prison.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul’s cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

occurrences.bsb: So when they came here with me, I did not delay. The next day I sat on the judgment seat and ordered that the man be brought in.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.

occurrences.bsb: The next day Agrippa and Bernice came with great pomp and entered the auditorium, along with the commanders and leading men of the city. And Festus ordered that Paul be brought in.
occurrences.kjv: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus’ commandment Paul was brought forth.

occurrences.bsb: Then Festus said, “King Agrippa and all who are present with us, you see this man. The whole Jewish community has petitioned me about him, both here and in Jerusalem, crying out that he ought not to live any longer.
occurrences.kjv: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

occurrences.bsb: “Men, I can see that our voyage will be filled with disaster and great loss, not only to ship and cargo, but to our own lives as well.”
occurrences.kjv: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

occurrences.bsb: After the men had gone a long time without food, Paul stood up among them and said, “Men, you should have followed my advice not to sail from Crete. Then you would have averted this disaster and loss.
occurrences.kjv: But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them, and said, Sirs, ye should have hearkened unto me, and not have loosed from Crete, and to have gained this harm and loss.

occurrences.bsb: So take courage, men, for I believe God that it will happen just as He told me.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.

occurrences.bsb: After three days, he called together the leaders of the Jews. When they had gathered, he said to them, “Brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or the customs of our fathers, I was taken prisoner in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.
occurrences.kjv: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will never count against him.”
occurrences.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

occurrences.bsb: For instance, a married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.
occurrences.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

occurrences.bsb: So then, if she is joined to another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.
occurrences.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

occurrences.bsb: And what was the divine reply to him? “I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
occurrences.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

occurrences.bsb: But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.

occurrences.bsb: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.
occurrences.kjv: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.

occurrences.bsb: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife.
occurrences.kjv: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.

occurrences.bsb: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.
occurrences.kjv: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:

occurrences.bsb: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.
occurrences.kjv: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.

occurrences.bsb: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.

occurrences.bsb: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified through his believing wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
occurrences.kjv: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.

occurrences.bsb: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
occurrences.kjv: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?

occurrences.bsb: and his interests are divided. The unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the work of the Lord, how she can be holy in both body and spirit. But the married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world, how she can please her husband.
occurrences.kjv: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

occurrences.bsb: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, as long as he belongs to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
occurrences.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

occurrences.bsb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
occurrences.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

occurrences.bsb: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
occurrences.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

occurrences.bsb: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.
occurrences.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.

occurrences.bsb: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
occurrences.kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

occurrences.bsb: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.
occurrences.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

occurrences.bsb: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,
occurrences.kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

occurrences.bsb: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.
occurrences.kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

occurrences.bsb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
occurrences.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

occurrences.bsb: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

occurrences.bsb: For it is written: “Rejoice, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have never travailed; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband.”
occurrences.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

occurrences.bsb: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, as we mature to the full measure of the stature of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

occurrences.bsb: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
occurrences.kjv: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

occurrences.bsb: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

occurrences.bsb: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
occurrences.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

occurrences.bsb: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
occurrences.kjv: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

occurrences.bsb: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
occurrences.kjv: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

occurrences.bsb: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.
occurrences.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
occurrences.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

occurrences.bsb: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
occurrences.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

occurrences.bsb: An overseer, then, must be above reproach, the husband of but one wife, temperate, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
occurrences.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

occurrences.bsb: A deacon must be the husband of but one wife, a good manager of his children and of his own household.
occurrences.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

occurrences.bsb: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to her husband,
occurrences.kjv: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

occurrences.bsb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
occurrences.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

occurrences.bsb: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
occurrences.kjv: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

occurrences.bsb: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
occurrences.kjv: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

occurrences.bsb: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love Him.
occurrences.kjv: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

occurrences.bsb: for man’s anger does not bring about the righteousness that God desires.
occurrences.kjv: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

occurrences.bsb: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
occurrences.kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

occurrences.bsb: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.
occurrences.kjv: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

occurrences.bsb: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
occurrences.kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

occurrences.bsb: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
occurrences.kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

occurrences.bsb: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves. They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands,
occurrences.kjv: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

occurrences.bsb: Husbands, in the same way, treat your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel, and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life, so that your prayers will not be hindered.
occurrences.kjv: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

occurrences.bsb: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
occurrences.kjv: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
